name: kxtrumppardon
title: Who will Trump pardon in 2026?
settlement: Each outcome market resolves Yes if the named person has been given a presidential pardon, commutation, or reprieve during Trump's second term and before Jan 1, 2027. Otherwise it resolves No.
decideContext: Estimate how this news changes the chance that each named person receives federal clemency (pardon, commutation or reprieve) from Trump before Jan 1, 2027. Each person's market is a separate yes/no question, and several can resolve Yes.
